p: summer fruit: Which signified the ripeness of their sins, and the readiness of God's judgments.
silence: There will be none left to mourn for them.

swallow up the needy: By stopping the sale of food and necessary things which you have gotten into your own hands, and so cause the poor to spend quickly that little that they have, and at length because of need to become your slaves.
new moon be gone: When the scarcity had come they were so greedy for gain, that they thought the holy day to be a hindrance to them.
the ephah small: That is, the measure small, and the price great.
drowned: That is, the inhabitants of the land will be drowned, as the Nile drowns many when it overflows.
sun to go down at noon: In the midst of their prosperity, I will send great affliction.
word of the LORD: By which he shows that they will not only perish in body, but also in soul for lack of God's word, which is the food of it.
of Samaria: For the idolaters used to swear by their idols, which here he calls their sin: and the papists yet swear by theirs.
The manner of Beersheba liveth: That is, the common manner of worshipping, and the service or religion used there.
